**Apex Institute of Technology**

• Established: 2005
• Location: Bangalore, Karnataka
• Affiliation: Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU)
• Approval: AICTE Approved
• Vision: To produce competent engineers with ethical values and technical excellence.
• Mission: To provide quality education, promote research, and foster innovation.

**College Timings**

• **Office**: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Monday to Friday)
• **Library**: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
• **Canteen**: 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM
• **Labs**: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

Note: During exams, extended hours may apply. Check the academic calendar.

**Contact Details**

• **Email**: info@apex.edu
• **Phone**: +91-80-12345678
• **Website**: www.apex.edu
• **Address**: Apex Institute of Technology, Bangalore, Karnataka

For department-specific queries, contact your HOD directly.

**College Holidays**

• **Weekly Off**: Sunday
• **Public Holidays**: As per government notification
• **Mid-term Break**: Typically during Dasara/Diwali (check academic calendar)
• **Summer Vacation**: May-June after semester exams

Holiday list is published at the beginning of each semester.

**Academic Calendar**

• **Odd Semester**: August to December
  - Classes start: August first week
  - Internal tests: September
  - Semester exams: December
  - Results: January

• **Even Semester**: January to May
  - Classes start: January second week
  - Internal tests: March
  - Semester exams: May
  - Results: June

Exact dates are announced at semester start.
